thread:
Alex M: quick heads-up — I'm sketching an RFC for automatic model-variant swap when a primary model hits sustained saturation. want opinions on API headers, console toggles, and telemetry signals.

Kayla D: +1. main risk is silent quality regressions. we need clear telemetry and opt-out per-tenant.

Priya S: Agree. Can we define "sustained saturation"? spikes vs steady-state matters for oscillation.

Alex M: thinking: two signals — (1) short window overload (p95 qps fill / slot exhaust) and (2) sustained high queue depth for X minutes. both must match thresholds to trigger auto-swap.

Ricardo G: Also add KV-cache warmup penalty — swapping to quantized variant might spike latencies for first 20s. need grace window or traffic siphon.

Sam O: UX: console should show a live "auto-swap" banner per-tenant with rollback button. users should see reason: capacity vs degraded model perf.

Kayla D: For API, propose header `X-Redwood-Auto-Swap: on|off|ask` and `X-Redwood-Variant-Preference: primary,compatible,cheaper`. default on for hosted; off for private by default.

Priya S: +1 to headers. Also return a structured response field when swap happens e.g. \"served_variant\": \"llama-2-13b-8q\" and \"swap_reason\": \"capacity_sustained\" so clients can log and eval.

Alex M: sample header block: ```
# request headers
Authorization: Bearer <key>
X-Redwood-Auto-Swap: on
X-Redwood-Variant-Preference: compatible
```

Ricardo G: Telemetry wise we should emit these metrics per-tenant and per-model: `swap_attempts`, `swap_successes`, `swap_rollback_count`, `avg_latency_before_swap`, `avg_latency_after_swap`, `quality_regression_alerts` (tied to eval snippets).

Sam O: console: add timeline view showing when swap started, primary slot pressure, and a button to pin tenant to primary (manual override). plus a toggle to simulate swap in dry-run.

Priya S: For safety, require N consecutive windows (e.g., 3 x 30s) before swap; include random jitter to avoid many tenants swapping at once.

Alex M: deployment/ops question — when swap to cheaper variant fails capacity (e.g., it's also saturated), should we cascade to region fallback or apply backpressure (429)?

Ricardo G: prefer cascade: prefer compatible variants in same region, then cheaper cross-region if tenant allows. final fallback: respond 429 with clear `Retry-After` and `x-redwood-fallback: none` meta.

Kayla D: Edge case: tenant pinned to specific model version via API. we must respect pin and instead surface a clear SLA warning and return 429 if pinned primary is saturated.

Alex M: draft API semantics: - pinned model -> no auto-swap, return 429 + `x-redwood-limited: pinned_model_saturated` - auto-swap off header -> prefer queue/backpressure - auto-swap on -> attempt variants per policy chain.

Sam O: ops-bot: can we get a small prod feature flag for 2 weeks to test with 10% of traffic?

ops-bot: feature-flag created: `auto_variant_swap_v1` - rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% (manual). Dry-run mode available.

Priya S: telemetry alerting: add an SLO that triggers if quality_regression_alerts > threshold within 1h after swaps. tie to rollback automation?

Alex M: good call. propose automated rollback if quality regression > 5% and user-visible error rate unchanged. manual override persists for 24h unless tenant unpins.

Ricardo G: implement a canary: first enable for non-paying sandbox tenants and internal test accounts; measure avg latency change and embedding similarity drift on eval sets.

Kayla D: console language: avoid "fallback" for end-users — use "variant swap" and reason line e.g., "Primary model saturated; temporarily serving compatible variant".

Alex M: thanks all. I'll assemble RFC: will include sample headers, telemetry list, console mockups, cascading policy, and safe rollback rules. tagging @Kayla D @Priya S for review before I post to eng RFCs.

Sam O: thanks Alex. I'm happy to own console toggles + rollout flag.

Priya S: I'll draft the metric definitions and eval harness snippets.

Ricardo G: I'll prototype the variant selection algorithm and cache-warmup strategy.

Alex M: perfect — aiming to post RFC by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
